business_summary: Axis Consulting Corporation, together with its subsidiary, provides talent acquisition, recruitment, and skill-sharing services in Japan. The company offers AXIS Agent, a consultant recruitment and career change support services; and AXIS Solutions, a management and business challenge support service provided by independent freelance consultants. It also provides compass share, a service that supports corporations that utilize third-party experiences and insights for various purposes, such as business consultation work, document creation, and training; and CxO-Pass, a matching service that allows startup founders to welcome CxO talent. In addition, the company offers system design, development, testing, operation, maintenance, and infrastructure construction. It serves business companies and consulting firms. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
